provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific measurement/decision example; stipulated model inputs and observations, not new experimental findings.
provenance.scope: All required information, units and inferential limits are in this document.

assignment: Uniformly choose exactly two of the four intact clusters for treatment; the other two are controls. All six assignments are equally likely. Potential means and cluster sizes in this controlled finite population are fixed; there is no interference between clusters and all units in a cluster share its assigned arm. These complete potential outcomes are public for design evaluation, not estimated from an actual trial.
target: Finite-population average treatment effect over all20 units, weighted by cluster size. Define the Horvitz-Thompson estimator as1/N sum[Z_g*T_g(1)/.5-(1-Z_g)*T_g(0)/.5], with potential cluster total T_g(z)=size_g*mean_g(z). Separately define the ratio estimator as observed treated-unit mean minus observed control-unit mean. Evaluate design expectations and variance over all six assignments; do not replace the denominator by a realized arm size in the HT estimator.
scope: A controlled generic clustered-intervention design; no recommendation or real causal estimate is implied.
